confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate calibrated to the supplied comparables; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Food and hostel anchors are the most reliable; the three-star hotel rate varies widely by district and date. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draught serving to match the comparables. Cocktail (about 2.3x beer) and wine (about 2x beer) follow the local beer relationship because direct price knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated mainly to Penang, Malaysia, as the closest domestic comparable. Kuala Lumpur is set modestly higher for beer, mid-range dining and capital-city lodging. Nha Trang and Vientiane serve as lower-cost regional bounds for food and budget rooms.
